items.summary: 腾讯开源了 DFly2，这是一个针对稀疏注意力 LLM 的推测性解码起草器。每个草稿层都重用目标的 KV 缓存和 top-k 索引器选择，无需添加草稿 KV 内存，并将 64K 服务吞吐量提升高达 81%。
items.summary_orig: Tencent open-sourced DFly2, a speculative decoding drafter for sparse-attention LLMs. Each draft layer reuses the target's KV cache and top-k indexer picks, adding no draft KV memory and lifting 64K serving throughput by up to 81%.

items.title: Firecracker 用令牌桶为网络、磁盘和熵源限速
items.title_orig: Firecracker rate limiters: token buckets for network, disk and entropy, worked through
items.summary: Firecracker 在每个模拟设备上加令牌桶限速器，配置只是几个整数，很容易设成与预期不符的值。
items.summary_orig: A microVM that can push unlimited bytes through its network interface or its disk can make every other VM on the host slow. Firecracker's answer is a rate limiter on each emulated device, built from token buckets. The configuration is a handful of integers, and it is easy to set them to something that does not mean what you think.

items.summary_orig: Most apps don't do everything inside a single request. Sending an email, processing an upload, generating a report, syncing with another service, crunching a big dataset — all of that takes time. If you try to do it all inside an HTTP request, responses get slow, servers get overloaded, and things start breaking.

items.summary_orig: Jensen Huang, who resigned as Nvidia's CEO last week, would be willing to return as CEO if the company's board of directors wanted it, he said in a statement reported on by The Wall Street Journal. "Since my departure, I've seen an outpouring of calls from Nvidia's employees, investors, business partners, and customers for me […]

items.title: Cloudflare 加入 Jevolution 并将自己称为 Neolab
items.title_orig: Cloudflare Joins the Jevolution and Labels Itself a Neolab
items.summary: Cloudflare 因加速网络而名声大噪。现在，它正在构建 System One 模型，以便在毫秒内做出决策和提取数据。
items.summary_orig: Cloudflare made its name speeding up the web. Now it's building System One models to make decisions and pull data in milliseconds.

items.title: 第一批夸克和胶子是否经历了布朗运动？有时会。
items.title_orig: Did The First Quarks and Gluons Experience Brownian Motion? Sometimes.
items.summary: 早期宇宙的夸克-胶子等离子体经历了布朗运动，但一种新理论预测，当一个以接近光速运动的粒子穿过流体时，它很可能会受到流体的推力和拉力。结果表明，布朗统计并不总是适用。
items.summary_orig: The quark-gluon plasma of the early universe experienced Brownian motion, but a new theory predicts how a particle moving at close to the speed of light is likely to be pushed and pulled by a fluid as it flies through it. The result shows that Brownian statistics doesn't always apply.
